run_vos_inference_cli: run video object segmentation inference on a directory of videos using SAM 2 with input masks
run_vos_separate_inference: run per-object VOS inference on videos where objects appear later than the first frame
run_vos_with_all_masks: run VOS inference using all available input masks instead of only the first frame mask
review_vos_inference_function: review the vos_inference function that propagates segmentation masks throughout a video using SAM 2 predictor
review_vos_separate_inference_function: review the vos_separate_inference_per_object function that tracks objects independently across video frames
